claim: Do Anthropic's junior hiring changes prove AI agents displaced workers?
sourceFinding: Anthropic reported the share of junior technical recruits falling from 27% to 9% while internal agent usage rose.
evidenceLimits: A changing hiring share is not the number of eliminated jobs and does not establish effects across the whole economy.
nextEvidenceTrigger: Independent cross-company data on absolute junior hiring, agent adoption and causality.
integrityRule: Append-only revisions: never overwrite this snapshot. Future evidence changes require a new version and review.
